verses.en: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Issacar foram quatro: Tolá, Pua, Jasube, e Sinrom.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah, Jashub and Shimron, four.

verses.en: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father’s house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Tolá foram: Uzi, Refaías, Jeriel, Jamai, Ibsão e Samuel, cabeças das famílias de seus pais. De Tolá foram contados por suas genealogias no tempo de Davi vinte e dois mil seiscentos homens guerreiros.
verses.en_web: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah and Jeriel and Jahmai and Ibsam and Shemuel, heads of their families; they were men of war; in the record of their generations their number in the time of David was twenty-two thousand, six hundred.

verses.en: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
verses.pt: O filho de Uzi foi Izraías; e os filhos de Izraías foram: Micael, Obadias, Joel, e Issias; todos estes cinco foram líderes.
verses.en_web: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah; and the sons of Izrahiah: Michael and Obadiah and Joel and Isshiah, five; all of them chiefs.

verses.en: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
verses.pt: E havia com eles em suas genealogias, segundo as famílias de seus pais, trinta e seis mil homens de guerra, porque tiveram muitas mulheres e filhos.
verses.en_web: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
verses.en_bbe: And with them, recorded in generations by their families, were bands of fighting-men, thirty-six thousand of them, for they had a great number of wives and sons.

verses.en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.pt: E seus irmãos em todas as famílias de Issacar, todos contados por suas genealogias, foram oitenta e sete mil guerreiros valentes.
verses.en_web: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.
verses.en_bbe: And there were recorded among all the families of Issachar, great men of war, eighty-seven thousand.

verses.en: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Benjamim foram três: Belá, Bequer, e Jediael.
verses.en_web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Benjamin: Bela and Becher and Jediael, three.

verses.en: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Belá foram: Esbom, Uzi, Uziel, Jerimote, e Iri; cinco cabeças de famílias paternas, guerreiros valentes, dos quais foram contados por suas genealogias vinte e dois mil e trinta e quatro.
verses.en_web: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon and Uzzi and Uzziel and Jerimoth and Iri, five; heads of their families, great men of war; there were twenty-two thousand and thirty-four of them recorded by their families.

verses.en: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Bequer: Zemira, Joás, Eliézer, Elioenai, Onri, Jerimote, Abias, Anatote e Alemete; todos estes foram filhos de Bequer.
verses.en_web: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah and Joash and Eliezer and Elioenai and Omri and Jerimoth and Abijah and Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

verses.en: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of the fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.pt: E foram contados por suas genealogias, segundo suas descendências, e os cabeças de suas famílias, vinte mil e duzentos guerreiros valentes.
verses.en_web: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.
verses.en_bbe: And they were recorded by their generations, heads of their families, great men of war, twenty thousand, two hundred.

verses.en: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.pt: E o filho de Jediael foi Bilã; e os filhos de Bilã foram: Jeús, Benjamim, Eúde, Quenaaná, Zetã, Társis, e Aisaar.
verses.en_web: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan: Jeush and Benjamin and Ehud and Chenaanah and Zethan and Tarshish and Ahishahar.

verses.en: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
verses.pt: Todos estes filhos de Jediael foram cabeças de famílias, guerreiros valentes, dezessete mil e duzentos que saíam com o exército para a guerra.
verses.en_web: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
verses.en_bbe: All these were the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their families, seventeen thousand, two hundred men of war, able to go out with the army for war.

verses.en: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.pt: Supim e Hupim foram filhos de Ir; e Husim foi filho de Aer.
verses.en_web: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
verses.en_bbe: And Shuppim and Huppim. The sons of Dan, Hushim his son, one.

verses.en: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Naftali foram: Jaziel, Guni, Jezer, e Salum, filhos de Bila.
verses.en_web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel and Guni and Jezer and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

verses.en: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Manassés foram: Asriel, o qual foi nascido de sua concubina, a síria, a qual também lhe deu à luz Maquir, pai de Gileade.
verses.en_web: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Manasseh by his servant-wife, the Aramaean woman: she gave birth to Machir, the father of Gilead;

verses.en: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.pt: E Maquir tomou por mulher a irmã de Hupim e Supim, cuja irmã teve por nome Maaca. O nome do segundo foi Zelofeade. E Zelofeade teve somente filhas.
verses.en_web: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.en_bbe: (And Gilead took a wife, whose name was Maacah, and his sister's name was Hammoleketh;) and the name of his brother was Zelophehad, who was the father of daughters.

verses.en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.pt: E Maaca mulher de Maquir lhe gerou um filho, e chamou seu nome Perez; e o nome de seu irmão foi Seres, cujos filhos foram Ulão e Requém.
verses.en_web: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.en_bbe: And Maacah, the wife of Gilead, gave birth to a son to whom she gave the name Peresh; and his brother was named Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

verses.en: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.pt: E o filho de Ulão foi Bedã. Estes foram os filhos de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés.
verses.en_web: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir the son of Manasseh.

verses.en: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
verses.pt: E sua irmã Hamolequete deu à luz Isode, Abiezer, e Maalá.
verses.en_web: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.en_bbe: And his sister Hammoleketh was the mother of Ishhod and Abiezer and Mahlah.

verses.en: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Semida foram Aiã, Siquém, Liqui, e Anião.
verses.en_web: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian and Shechem and Likhi and Aniam.

verses.en: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.pt: Os filhos de Efraim: Sutela, seu filho Berede, seu filho Taate, seu filho Eleada, seu filho Taate,
verses.en_web: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,

verses.en: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.pt: Seu filho Zabade, seu filho Sutela, seu filho, Ézer, e Eleade. Mas os homens de Gate, naturais daquela terra, os mataram, porque desceram para tomar seus gados.
verses.en_web: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
verses.en_bbe: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead, whom the men of Gath, who had been living in the land from their birth, put to death, because they came down to take away their cattle.

verses.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.pt: Por isso seu pai Efraim esteve de luto por muitos dias, e seus irmãos vieram consolá-lo.
verses.en_web: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
verses.en_bbe: And for a long time Ephraim their father went on weeping for them, and his brothers came to give him comfort.

verses.en: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.pt: Depois ele se deitou com sua mulher, ela concebeu, e deu à luz um filho, ao qual chamou por nome Berias, pois o desastre havia ocorrido em sua casa.
verses.en_web: He went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
verses.en_bbe: After that, he had connection with his wife, and she became with child and gave birth to a son, to whom his father gave the name of Beriah, because trouble had come on his family.

verses.en: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)
verses.pt: E sua filha foi Seerá, a qual edificou a Bete-Horom, a baixa e a alta, como também a Uzém-Seerá.
verses.en_web: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
verses.en_bbe: And his daughter was Sheerah, the builder of Beth-horon the lower and the higher, and Uzzen-sheerah.

verses.en: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.pt: E seu filho foi Refa, seu filho Resefe, seu filho Telá, seu filho Taã,
verses.en_web: Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, Tahan his son,
verses.en_bbe: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph; his son was Telah, and his son was Tahan;

verses.en: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.pt: Seu filho Laadã, seu filho Amiúde, seu filho Elisama,
verses.en_web: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.en_bbe: Ladan was his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

verses.en: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.
verses.pt: Seu filho Num, e seu filho Josué.
verses.en_web: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
verses.en_bbe: Nun his son, Joshua his son.

verses.en: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
verses.pt: E a propriedade e habitação deles foi Betel com suas aldeias, e ao oriente Naarã, e ao ocidente Gezer e suas aldeias, como também Siquém com suas aldeias, até Aia e suas aldeias;
verses.en_web: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
verses.en_bbe: Their heritage and their living-places were Beth-el and its daughter-towns, and Naaran to the east, and Gezer to the west, with its daughter-towns, as well as Shechem and its daughter-towns as far as Azzah and its daughter-towns;

verses.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.pt: E da parte dos filhos de Manassés, Bete-Seã com suas aldeias, Taanaque com suas aldeias, Megido com suas aldeias, e Dor com suas aldeias. Nestes lugares habitaram os filhos de José, filho de Israel.
verses.en_web: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
verses.en_bbe: And by the limits of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, with their daughter-towns. In these the children of Joseph, the son of Israel, were living.

verses.en: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Aser foram: Imná, Isvá, Isvi, Berias, e sua irmã Sera.
verses.en_web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Asher: Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah and Serah, their sister.

verses.en: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Berias foram: Héber, e Malquiel, o qual foi pai de Bizarvite.
verses.en_web: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

verses.en: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.pt: E Héber gerou a Jaflete, Semer, Hotão, e sua irmã Suá.
verses.en_web: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.en_bbe: And Heber was the father of Japhlet and Shomer and Hotham and Shua, their sister.

verses.en: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jaflete foram: Pasaque, Bimal, e Asvate. Estes foram os filhos de Jaflete.
verses.en_web: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach and Bimhal and Ashvath. These are the sons of Japhlet.

verses.en: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Semer foram: Aí, Roga, Jeubá, e Arã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Shomer: Ahi and Rohgah, Jehubbah and Aram.

verses.en: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.pt: Os filhos de seu irmão Helém foram: Zofa, Imná, Seles, e Amal.
verses.en_web: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Hotham, his brother: Zophah and Imna and Shelesh and Amal.

verses.en: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.pt: Os filhos de Zofa foram: Suá, Harnefer, Sual, Beri, Inra,
verses.en_web: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Zophah: Suah and Harnepher and Shual and Beri and Imrah,

verses.en: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.pt: Bezer, Hode, Samá, Silsa, Iltrã e Beera.
verses.en_web: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
verses.en_bbe: Bezer and Hod and Shamma and Shilshah and Ithran and Beera.

verses.en: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jéter foram: Jefoné, Pispa, e Ara.
verses.en_web: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh and Pispah and Ara.

verses.en: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Ula foram; Ara, Haniel, e Rizia.
verses.en_web: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Ulla: Arah and Hanniel and Rizia.

verses.en: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father’s house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
verses.pt: Todos estes foram filhos de Aser, cabeças de famílias paternas, escolhidos guerreiros valentes, chefes de príncipes; e foram contados em suas genealogias no exército para a guerra, em número de vinte e seis mil homens.
verses.en_web: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
verses.en_bbe: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their families, specially strong men of war, chiefs of the rulers. They were recorded in the army for war, twenty-six thousand men in number.
